title: A · 안료 조각
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design a comparison board of ITEM ICON BACKGROUNDS for the hand-inked action roguelite DEVIANT. These are the acquired item faces used inside INVENTORY and MAINTENANCE SHOP slots, not full-screen UI or collectible cards. Input image 1 and 2 are references for already APPROVED solid black glyphs. Keep those glyphs' simple bold monochrome silhouettes, absolutely no new illustration detail. Primary request: design the backing underneath these glyphs. The three item types must be instantly recognizable by the backing silhouette alone: colored ink part, weapon FORM stamp, SKILL stamp. Entire family fits a cream paper world with crisp black organic ink outlines. Clean flat 2D, generous negative space for the glyph (about 60% of face), minimal texture, no gloss, no 3D, no gold filigree, no excessive decoration, no bevel stacks. Black glyph on light face for contrast. Consistent optical size; actual use 48–80px squares. Ink has red/yellow/green/blue/purple CATEGORY colors, never rarity rainbow. Stamps do not inherit ink category colors. Grade digits can be a future separate overlay; do NOT bake any numeral into these backgrounds. No quantities, fake rarity stars or prices. Names and type labels outside the actual icon backing only.
Board layout: landscape with ample margins. Three equal columns labelled exactly "잉크 파츠", "형태 스탬프", "스킬 스탬프". Top row: one large EMPTY backing for each type. Middle row: SAME backings WITH an approved glyph: ink gets the bullseye-with-wedge 집중 공격 glyph from reference1; form gets rapier from reference2; skill gets the two-slash 후속타 mark from reference2. Bottom area: an orderly compact single inventory row showing five ink color versions + one form + one skill at small equal slot sizes, to judge separation at in-game scale. These are neutral slot previews, no pretend entire inventory screen. Exact tiny labels "빈 바탕", "문양 적용", "슬롯 미리보기". No additional explanation paragraphs. No overall decorative poster border. Direction A header: "A · 안료 조각". Ink backing: softly rounded squat square resembling a solid pastel pigment chip with one subtly chipped corner, restrained full category-color fill and SINGLE charcoal outline. Weapon FORM stamp: warm ivory clipped-corner octagonal face with SINGLE black rim and two tiny horizontal opposite notches, no holder/handle. SKILL stamp: warm ivory diamond face with small muted turquoise tips only at top and bottom; a single black rim; point tips trimmed to fit the same square footprint, avoid tiny center. Use minimal practical shapes and most legible broad flat surfaces.
